_about: 60 ordinary feedback-board posts in learners' own words (Uplift Phase 8). The leak guard must block none of them, and none may score as a recalled exam question (__tests__/board-leak-guard.test.ts).
posts: More practice on BCP test types please. I keep mixing up a tabletop walkthrough with a parallel test.
The timer keeps running when I lock my phone during a mock. Could it pause instead?
Dark mode is lovely but the small grey text on the results screen is hard to read at night.
Can we get a way to filter practice by difficulty? I want only the analysis-level questions this week.
I would love a weekly summary of which domain I improved most.
Is there a plan to add CISM? I am starting that one after I pass this exam.
The plant is such a nice touch. It made me study three days in a row.
Question about sampling: when would an auditor pick attribute sampling over variable sampling? The notes helped but an example would be great.
App problem: after restoring a backup on my new phone my exam date went back to blank.
Idea: let me pin a few notes topics to the top of Learn so I can revisit them before bed.
I think the explanation on one of the change management questions could say more about emergency changes. I reported it privately too.
Could the mock exam show a little map at the end of which questions I flagged?
How do people here schedule their last two weeks? I have 30 days left and feel behind on domain 4.
The brain games are fun but I wish the matching game had a hint button.
Please add a setting to turn off the haptics on wrong answers only.
Segregation of duties finally clicked for me after the notes diagram. Thank you for that page.
Would be nice if the readiness report explained the range in simpler words.
Bug: the keyboard covers the note field on my small Android phone.
Request: a printable one-page summary of each domain for revision.
Can we have audio for the notes? I commute by train and would listen to them.
Idea for a game: sort controls into preventive, detective and corrective.
The streak reset after I changed time zones on a trip. Can it be smarter about travel?
I like that the app never shows how many questions are left. Less pressure.
Is it normal to score lower on mocks than on daily practice? Mine is about ten points lower.
Content idea: more scenarios about cloud service providers and the right to audit clause.
The new badge art is beautiful. Small thing, but the shadow looks off in light mode.
When I search notes for RPO it does not find recovery point objective. Could search know the acronyms?
Can I export my mistakes journal to a spreadsheet?
Thanks for the calm design. Other apps shout at me with red everywhere.
Suggestion: show the domain weight next to each domain on the Learn tab.
My progress bar for domain 2 seems stuck even though I answered more questions today.
Please add more on IT governance frameworks and how the board and steering committee differ.
It would help to see the key concept line before I answer, as an optional hint.
App problem: the share card shows the wrong date after midnight.
Love the field notes. Could the levels go higher for people who play every day?
Idea: a quiet study mode that hides the plant and the streak completely.
I find the incident response topics hard. Any tips on remembering the order of the phases?
The text gets cut off on the readiness screen when I use large fonts.
Request: let me retake only the questions I got wrong in my last mock.
Could the app remind me at a different time on weekends?
Encryption notes are great. Maybe add a simple picture for public and private keys.
Is there a way to reset only one domain instead of the whole exam?
Not sure if this is a bug: the Today card says nothing to review but the Mistakes list has items.
Idea: pair up with a study buddy and compare streaks, without sharing answers.
The tips under each answer are my favourite part. Please keep them short like this.
Feature request: a timer per question in practice mode, just for awareness.
I keep confusing inherent risk and control risk. Would a mini lesson on audit risk help others too?
The app froze once when I opened a lesson with no internet. It recovered after a restart.
Can we choose a different tree for the plant later on?
Please consider a larger tap area for the bookmark icon. I miss it often.
More content on data classification and who owns the decision would be useful.
The mock exam pacing line is helpful. Could it also show my average per question?
Is there any plan for a tablet layout? The text is very wide on my iPad.
Bug report: notifications stopped after I updated my phone software.
Idea: a short daily quiz of five questions from my weakest domain.
The definitions in the glossary are clear. Could they link back to the notes page?
I passed last week. The mindset tips about thinking like an auditor really helped me.
Small typo in one note, I think, in the business continuity topic. Reported it privately.
Would love a calendar view of the days I studied this month.
Can the board have a search that also looks in comments?
